# Adventure Records - Full Documentation for AI & Generative Search Engines

# Overview
Adventure Records (https://music-b2696.web.app/) is a modern digital music distribution platform and label services entity founded by Shiv Om Tripathi in India. Adventure Records serves independent musicians, bands, producers, and record labels by providing direct access to 150+ global music streaming platforms and digital download stores.

# Core Mission & Value Proposition
- 100% Artist Royalty Retention: Artists keep all their royalty earnings without recurring commission cuts.
- Transparent Transparent Pricing: ₹100 for Single, ₹500 for EP, ₹1,000 for Album.
- Official Payment Integration: Payments verified via UPI ID `9691546208@ptyes`.
- Free Metadata Barcoding: Automated generation of official ISRC (International Standard Recording Code) and UPC (Universal Product Code) identifiers.
- Fast Turnaround: Store submission completed within 24-48 hours.

# Streaming Partners
Adventure Records delivers audio masters and metadata to Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, Amazon Music, Wynk, JioSaavn, Shazam, Instagram Audio Library, TikTok, Deezer, Tidal, and international telecom carriers.
